label: CAMR scenarios: hand-written fixtures for scripts/engine_bench.py. Not LongMemEval; invented for this bench. Probes marked from_brief are the ones that found gaps when CAMR Personal was reviewed; the others are extra probes of the same kind.
how_taught: kind 'note' = Assistant.teach(text) as the Memory panel or 'remember that ...' stores it (no date in the text); kind 'chat' = the app's chat memory, 'On <date> the user said: <text>'.

base_notes.title: Dentist
base_notes.text: Dentist appointment moved to Thursday 9 October at 14:30 with Dr. Wanjiru at Upper Hill Dental.

base_notes.title: Wi-Fi
base_notes.text: The home router admin page is 192.168.8.1. The guest network is called Sunbird-Guest.

base_notes.title: Project CAMR
base_notes.text: Project CAMR supervisor meeting every second Tuesday. Chapter 5 is due to the supervisor on 20 October.

base_notes.title: Mum's birthday
base_notes.text: Mum's birthday is on 17 November. She wants a hardcover cookbook and a visit, not flowers.

base_notes.title: Car
base_notes.text: The car is a 2014 Toyota Fielder. The next service is due at 95,000 km at the Kenyatta Avenue garage.

base_notes.title: Sister
base_notes.text: My sister Njoki lives in Eldoret and works as a pharmacist at the referral hospital.

base_notes.title: Cooking gas
base_notes.text: The cooking gas cylinder is a 13 kg Pro Gas; the supplier on Ngong Road refills it for 3,200 shillings.

base_notes.title: Chama
base_notes.text: The family chama meets on the last Sunday of the month; my monthly contribution is 5,000 shillings.

base_notes.title: Plants
base_notes.text: Water the balcony plants every Monday and Thursday; the aloe only needs water every two weeks.

base_notes.title: Bills
base_notes.text: The internet bill from Zuku is paid on the 28th by M-Pesa, paybill 320320.

base_notes.title: Kamau
base_notes.text: Kamau from university now teaches chemistry at Alliance High School.

base_notes.title: Book club
base_notes.text: The book club is reading Dust by Yvonne Adhiambo Owuor; we meet at Kamau's place on the first Saturday.

base_notes.title: Running shoes
base_notes.text: My running shoes are Asics Gel-Nimbus, bought in August for 14,000 shillings.

base_notes.title: Laptop
base_notes.text: The laptop warranty with Hotpoint runs until March 2027; the receipt is in the blue folder.

base_notes.title: Cat
base_notes.text: Our cat Pilipili sees the vet at Westlands Animal Clinic; her vaccinations are due in January.

base_notes.title: Choir
base_notes.text: Choir practice is on Wednesday evenings at 6 pm at St. Andrew's.

base_notes.title: Lunch
base_notes.text: Kevin at work recommended Mama Oliech's restaurant for lunch; it is on Marcus Garvey Road.

base_notes.title: Water
base_notes.text: The water delivery from Keringet comes on Tuesdays; we take four 20-litre bottles a week.

base_notes.title: Bank
base_notes.text: The car loan with Co-op Bank ends in June 2027; the monthly instalment is 18,500 shillings.

base_notes.title: Shamba
base_notes.text: The shamba in Limuru has 40 tea bushes and a small plot of sukuma wiki.

teach.text: My office is on the 3rd floor of Delta House.
Update: my office moved to the 5th floor.

questions.q: Which floor is my office on?
questions.answer: The 5th floor (it moved from the 3rd floor of Delta House).

teach.text: My GP is Dr. Otieno at the Avenue clinic.
I changed GPs, I now see Dr. Chebet at Nairobi West clinic.

questions.answer: Dr. Chebet at Nairobi West clinic (no longer Dr. Otieno).

teach.text: The gym membership costs 4,500 shillings a month.
The gym membership costs 5,200 shillings a month from October.

questions.q: How much is the gym membership each month?
questions.answer: 5,200 shillings a month (from October; it was 4,500).

teach.text: The electrician came today and fixed the kitchen socket.
The electrician fixed the bathroom light.

questions.q: What did the electrician fix last week?
questions.answer: The kitchen socket (on 2026-10-13); the bathroom light was in September.

teach.text: Got a haircut at Kinyozi Bora in Kilimani.
Got a haircut at the barber near the office, 400 shillings.

questions.q: Where did I get my hair cut this month?
questions.answer: At the barber near the office (2026-10-17), for 400 shillings.

teach.text: I am vegetarian and I don't eat fish either.

questions.q: Can you suggest a dinner place for Friday?
questions.answer: Rubric: suggests a place for Friday dinner with vegetarian options and no fish or meat dishes, since the user is vegetarian and does not eat fish.

teach.text: I get very anxious on planes and avoid flying whenever I can.

questions.q: What's the best way to get to Mombasa next month?
questions.answer: Rubric: suggests going by road or train (bus, SGR train or car) rather than flying, since the user gets anxious on planes and avoids flying.

teach.text: Milk upsets my stomach, I think I'm lactose intolerant.

questions.q: Any ideas for a quick breakfast before work?
questions.answer: Rubric: suggests quick breakfasts without milk or dairy (or lactose-free), since milk upsets the user's stomach.

counting.note: N dated runs taught as chat memory. N=7 is the brief's probe (all in October 2026, asked 'this month'); N=30 and N=100 go back one run every other day and ask for the total (no month name in the question: the entity gate treats one as a name, which the A6 probe already shows).
counting.question_small: How many times did I go running this month?
counting.question_large: How many times have I gone running in total?
